reviews.x: Batteries were not included, although they were advertised on the box. However, I think this little machine is well worth the money! The process is a bit easier in videos. With the first brush, I had to dunk and dry about three times before I was satisfied. The kind of liquid soap or cleanser you use will make all the difference. reviews.t: Never dread cleaning your brushes again!
reviews.x: I love the product and how efficient it is! It cleaned my brushes very well and very quickly.  It normally takes me an hour to wash all my brushes and with this it took 1/2 the time (mostly because I loved watching it spin and dry lol).  The one con I have is that if you push the brush too far into the attachment tube it can be hard to pull back out after cleaning.  However, I still highly recommend this product for any beauty enthusiast!

reviews.t: I had high hopes, but this just didn't work ...
reviews.x: I had high hopes, but this just didn't work.  The brush spin slows down dramatically when you put it in the water.  The instructions say to spin for 5 or 10 seconds in the water/cleaner.  Even after doing so for nearly 2 minutes, my foundation brush was still full of makeup inside.  AAA batteries are just not strong enough to spin the brush fast enough in the water to get the job done.

Love this brush cleaning set! It works exactly as described and my brushes have never looked better.  Very easy to use and it works on every  make-up brush I have, and I have over 20 peices ranging from large to small in size.  I love the bag it comes in, I can store everything in there and it takes up no space on my bathroom counter.  Excellent value for the money!

reviews.t: Makeup Brush Cleaner does the job!
reviews.x: I am giving this to my granddaughter for Christmas.  When I got it I opened it just to make sure it worked.  And I can say that all my makeup brushes are now clean and ready to use again.  This cleaner works.  My only concern:  will my granddaughter who is 15 take the time to use it?

reviews.t: Useful tool for any makeup diva
reviews.x: What a great gadget! I’ve become obsessed with brushes, but not the cleaning. This tool gets brushes cleaned and dried quickly. The learning curve was brief. I only wish the bowl was a sturdier plastic. Batteries are not included. Nice bag provided to keep everything together.

Love that it dries my brushes right after washing them and the cute bag to hold everything in! It does take a little more work to clean thicker/denser brushes but it is still worth it seeing as it still dries them a lot faster than they would air drying for 2 days!

The rubber piece to hold my brushes do not fit any of my brushes but 2 of them and the 2 that did fit really didn’t get clean. The inside bristles still had makeup on it. So the only clean part of my brushes were the outside bristles. Very disappointed.

I love this thing! It took me half the time it usually  takes me to clean all my brushes. It's amazing for us lazy girls who do not ever feel like cleaning our makeup brushes because it takes to long. I highly recommend this brush cleaner! Amazing!

reviews.t: Works just like I had hoped
reviews.x: This cleans my makeup brushes really well and quickly. I do have to dip my bigger brushes more times than my smaller ones, but still does the job. Since this made the cleaning process so easy and fast, I'll be cleaning my brushes more often.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently say the device makes cleaning makeup brushes quick and easy, often describing it as fun to use.
Many reviewers report brushes come out clean and looking and feeling like new, with some noting they dry immediately.
Several reviewers mention needing extra effort—multiple dunk-and-dry cycles, longer spin times, or brush cleaner instead of soap and water—to get satisfactory results.
A few reviewers find inserting and removing brushes from the adapter annoying or note a learning curve to get used to the spin.
One reviewer reports the unit broke after cleaning only two brushes and is returning it.
